verses.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor um cântico novo, porque ele tem feito maravilhas; a sua destra e o seu braço santo lhe alcançaram a vitória.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm.> O make a new song to the Lord, because he has done works of wonder; with his right hand, and with his holy arm, he has overcome.

verses.en: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.pt: O Senhor fez notória a sua salvação, manifestou a sua justiça perante os olhos das nações.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has given to all the knowledge of his salvation; he has made clear his righteousness in the eyes of the nations.

verses.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.pt: Lembrou-se da sua misericórdia e da sua fidelidade para com a casa de Israel; todas as extremidades da terra viram a salvação do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.en_bbe: He has kept in mind his mercy and his unchanging faith to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.pt: Celebrai com júbilo ao Senhor, todos os habitantes da terra; dai brados de alegria, regozijai-vos, e cantai louvores.
verses.en_web: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
verses.en_bbe: Let all the earth send out a glad cry to the Lord; sounding with a loud voice, and praising him with songs of joy.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor com a harpa; com a harpa e a voz de canto.
verses.en_web: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.en_bbe: Make melody to the Lord with instruments of music; with a corded instrument and the voice of song.

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.pt: Com trombetas, e ao som de buzinas, exultai diante do Rei, o Senhor.
verses.en_web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: With wind instruments and the sound of the horn, make a glad cry before the Lord, the King.

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.pt: Brame o mar e a sua plenitude, o mundo e os que nele habitam;
verses.en_web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.en_bbe: Let the sea be thundering, with all its waters; the world, and all who are living in it;

verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.pt: batam palmas os rios; à uma regozijem-se os montes
verses.en_web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
verses.en_bbe: Let the streams make sounds of joy with their hands; let the mountains be glad together,

verses.en: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.pt: diante do Senhor, porque vem julgar a terra; com justiça julgará o mundo, e os povos com eqüidade.
verses.en_web: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.en_bbe: Before the Lord, for he has come as judge of the earth; judging the world in righteousness, and giving true decisions for the peoples.
